The kind-46 draw call is confirmed to go through the r4 trampoline slot (Func_080072f4 = games/gs1/asm/080072e4.s + 0x10, i.e. _call_via_r4) in both this draft's compiled output and the reference -- not a fixed-address direct call -- matching this session's project-wide _call_via_rN idiom.

The remaining 270 differing halfwords are overwhelmingly a single cascading register-allocation artifact, not a semantic/structural defect: the retained assembly and this draft agree on essentially every instruction's operation, operand values, field offsets, call arguments, and branch topology, but the reference keeps 'cache' in r6/'work' in r7 (this draft: r3->r6/r7 swapped) and keeps 'dst' in r9/'mode' in sl across the whole function (this draft: dst in fp, mode in r9) -- one early prologue register-allocation choice that then repeats at dozens of unrelated later sites. No PERM_GENERAL/PERM_INT hand-authored search or forced register assignment was applied (both are against project rules); five structural rewordings were tried and the best-scoring, most literal one was kept. This candidate claims zero DONE bytes and is not close enough to warrant a permuter run without first finding the specific source shape that drives that one register-allocation decision.
